data.voice_note: Voces: Nico y Astrid (en el zoo).
data.script: Nico: The elephant is eating! Its nose is like a big arm. … Astrid: The giraffe's neck is longer than a door! … Nico: Look, four monkeys! They are jumping from tree to tree. … Astrid: The lion is sleeping. Shhh! … Nico: The hippo is in the water. Only its eyes are out! … Astrid: My favourite is the bear. It's brown and very big. … Nico: And Pip says hello to the zoo birds. New friends!
